My analytics workflow

A consistent four-stage process across every project, ending in recommendations a business can act on.

1

Clean

Fix types, duplicates and gaps with Power Query or Pandas, then validate the totals.

2

Query

Join and aggregate with T-SQL so every KPI traces back to a clear definition.

3

Visualize

Build Power BI, Tableau or Excel dashboards with filters that answer follow-up questions.

4

Recommend

Finish with specific actions, like a pricing review or a staffing change.
